messages:
Nia: kicking off staged rollout for quant-kernel v2.4.0 — int8 path enabled by default. plan: canary 10% in us-west/us-east/eu-west -> 25% -> 50% -> global. tagging @SRE and @QA :rocket:
DeployBot: preflight OK: artifact quant-kernel:2.4.0 signed, smoke tests passed, infra checks green. trigger: /deploy canary --artifact quant-kernel:2.4.0 --regions us-west,us-east,eu-west --percent 10
CI-Bot: build 2.4.0 passed unit + integration suites. perf bench: microbench stable on p3.8xlarge.
Ben: before we go wide — can we pin high-risk customers (acme_corp, gov-health) to 2.3.9 for 72h? want to avoid surprise.
Nia: yes — please list customers we should pin. I'll add to rollout exclusion list.
Maria: publishing release notes draft here: https://gist.github.com/maria/quant-2-4-0-notes — highlights: int8 SSE kernels, improved kv-cache memory, bugfix for repeating tokens.
Raj: watch long-seq p95. last time int8 kernel bumped tail latency for >2048 tokens. set alert thresholds.
Nia: proposed rollback triggers: - p95 latency > 2x baseline for 5m OR - error rate spike > 3% absolute for 2 consecutive 1m windows OR - customer-facing 5xx > 1%
Tim: suggest hysteresis to avoid flapping: require trigger to persist for 3 consecutive 1m windows before auto-rollback, and require manual approval for full global rollback.
Ben: agreed on hysteresis. also do per-region thresholds (eu-west baseline higher, so use ratio checks).
DeployBot: executing canary. status: started. target shards: 120 nodes, distributed.
SRE-Bot: canary metrics (us-west, last 2m):
```
requests: 12k
error_rate: 0.9% (+0.2% vs baseline)
p95_latency: 210ms (+18ms)
queue_depth: stable
cpu_offload: 12% -> expected
```
SRE-Bot: nothing alarming yet, but p95 trending up in us-east — watching. :eyes:
Nia: thanks. pinning list from Ben: [acme_corp, gov-health, bank-1]. Ben, can you run pin commands?
Ben: pinned acme_corp and bank-1. Command: /deploybot pin acme_corp quant-kernel:2.3.9 --reason "sensitive latency SLAs"
Ben: pinned gov-health via infra ticket (gov rules require manual change).
CI-Bot: canary smoke logs excerpt:
```
[2026-03-20T10:12:05Z] model_init OK
[2026-03-20T10:12:07Z] quant-path int8 enabled
[2026-03-20T10:12:09Z] kvcache warm
[2026-03-20T10:12:20Z] request 0x7f -> success 200 in 198ms
[2026-03-20T10:13:05Z] request 0x8a -> success 502 (retry)
```
Raj: saw that 502 spike in eu-west earlier — correlated with a node that ran OOM-shrink and restarted. cause might be memory accounting change in 2.4.0.
Nia: ok we should hold the next ramp to 25% until SRE verifies memory bookkeeping on long sequences. put rollout on HOLD.
DeployBot: rollout paused at 10% by user request (Nia).
Tim: good call. next steps: 1) SRE to run mem-pressure test on 2.4.0 with 8k token sequences 2) QA to run regression suite against pinned customers 3) update release notes with known degraded node behavior and mitigation steps.
SRE-Bot: scheduled mem-pressure job: job-4829 queued, ETA ~20m. will post results.
Maria: I'll update the release notes and add a short "known issue" blurb referencing the hold and the pin commands.
Ben: after we verify, let's do a targeted 25% in us-west only for 1 hour before wider ramp. keep hysteresis in place.
Nia: agreed. thanks all. will reconvene when mem job finishes. :thumbsup:
